holdout_status: 2025 and 2026w1-10 previously inspected; new-method chronological diagnostics, not an untouched final evaluation
fold_design: For test year Y: base training seasons 2022..Y-2; probability calibration Y-1 weeks1-9; method/selection validation Y-1 weeks10-18; no post-validation refit
threshold_design: Per-market training-only residual quantiles20/50/80 around lag_anchor (50% last5 +50% career, available-lag fallback only), rounded down then +0.5; positive lines>=0.5; duplicate numeric thresholds removed
calibration: Monotone isotonic, 100 identity pseudogames for already probabilistic scores; no pseudo-probabilities for unbounded model scores; calibration split only
ensemble: Equal weight only among components independently passing prior validation: logloss gain>=1%, Brier no worse, calibration gap<=5pp and at least100 player-games. Otherwise explicit champion fallback. Components need not have independent errors.

selection.cutoff_selection: Lowest prior-validation cutoff satisfying every gate; otherwise abstain

promotion: Disabled. Compare all markets on identical test observations; paired week-block uncertainty and multiplicity correction. Genuine priced prospective evidence required for commercial adoption.
commercial_claims: No ROI, historical bookmaker hit rate, accumulator success or offered odds from statistical thresholds

evidence_gates.global_primary_test: Equal-market weekly log loss; multiplicity across six new method families; per-market comparisons exploratory with correction
evidence_gates.adoption: No automatic adoption: inspected periods and absent authentic prices cannot certify commercial performance

new_predictor_features: Lagged player/team statistics only; no champion point or sigma, bookmaker/closing-market inputs, observed test opportunities or same-game outcomes
reference_limitations: Archived champion/current-research forecasts retained as labelled comparisons; inherited market-input publication vintages remain unverified
weekly_decision_state: Only rows whose player-history availability precedes the earliest pregame decision within the NFL week; reconstructed conditional-participation cohort, not genuine offered markets
